verses.1: And it happened in the thirty-seventh year, on the fifth day of the month. I was on the banks of the Kebar River. Then the heavens opened, and I saw wonders from God.
verses.2: On the fifth day of the month, it was the fifth year since King Yoyachin’s reign began.
verses.3: It was the word of Jehovah to Jehizkiel, son of Buzi, the priest, in the land of Kadesh on the river Kebar. There, the hand of Jehovah was upon him.
verses.4: And I saw that a stormy wind came from the north. It was a huge cloud, and fire was being ejected from it. The fire surrounded it, just like a flame inside a fire.
verses.5: And within it lies the image of four living beings. And these images resemble the appearance of humans.
verses.6: And four faces to one, and four wings to another.
verses.7: And their feet were like those of a donkey, and their soles of their feet were like the soles of an ass’s feet. Their feet gleamed like needles that were full of poison.
verses.8: And the hands of a man are under its wings, on all four of them. Its face and wings also face in the same direction as its wings.
verses.9: The wings of a woman’s lover should not be damaged when she walks. They should remain intact, allowing her to move past anyone who stands in her way.
verses.10: And the faces of them were like the faces of humans and lions, on the right side for all four of them. And the faces of the cherubim were also on the right side for all four of them. And the faces of the seraphim were also on the right side for all four of them.
verses.11: And their faces and wings were covered with feathers, from above to below. They were two in number, one next to the other.
verses.12: And those who go beyond their faces will go towards what will become the “sky.” They will not be hindered in their journey.
verses.13: And the smell of living things resembles that of fire in a forest. It’s like the smell of burning wood. This smell moves among the living things, and it turns into fire. From this fire, sparks are produced.
verses.14: And the living creatures rushed forward and backward, just as the wind does.
verses.15: And I saw the living creatures. And there was one form among them on the earth, with four faces.
verses.16: Their appearance and actions are like those of a “tarashish”; they resemble each other in many ways. Their appearance and actions will be just as they will be when the “opan” is within the “opan”.
verses.17: On the four sides of them, as they walk, they will not be lost in their journey.
verses.18: And they would look up at her, and she would look down at them. Their breasts were filled with eyes around them.
verses.19: And as they walk along the paths of life, the devils will also follow them. And when they carry those lives away from the earth, the devils will also be carried away with them.
verses.20: For there, the wind will go away; the wind will leave. And those who are trapped in it will be freed from their plight, for the breath of life is in those who are trapped.
verses.21: As they walk, they will walk; as they stand, they will stand. And when they lift themselves up from the ground, the wings will be raised for them, for the spirit of life is in their wings.
verses.22: And a shadow covered the heads of the living beings, just like the bright ice that shines down upon their heads from above.
verses.23: And under the sky, their wings will carry a woman to her sister. She will be carried by two people who are covered with skins. They will carry their goods along with them.
verses.24: And I heard the sound of their wings, like the sound of a great sea. It was the sound of birds flying. Their wings made a humming sound, like the sound of a crowd standing still.
verses.25: And there was a sound on the sky, as if their wings were flapping in the wind.
verses.26: And above the sky that covers their heads, there is a sight like a throne. And on that throne, there’s a sight like a human being sitting upon it.
verses.27: And I saw it as if it were a flame, like fire. It was all around me, from above and below. I saw it as if it were fire, and it was burning everywhere.
verses.28: Just as the rainbow appears in the clouds on the day of rain, so too does the appearance around it resemble a shadow of God’s glory. I see this shadow on my face, and I hear a voice speaking to me.
